name: Jen-Hsun Huang
current_role: Co-founder, President and CEO, Nvidia
deep_cut_fact: He was a serious junior table-tennis player: he scrubbed floors at Portland's Paddle Palace club to pay for tournaments, and at 15 finished third in junior doubles at the U.S. Open Table Tennis Championships.

name: Bill Gates
current_role: Chair, Gates Foundation; founder of Breakthrough Energy and TerraPower; Microsoft co-founder
deep_cut_fact: A Costa Rican hoverfly, Eristalis gatesi ('Bill Gates' flower fly'), was named after him in 1997 by entomologist Chris Thompson in recognition of his contributions to the PC revolution; a sister species was named for Paul Allen. Also: his first company, Traf-O-Data (1972, with Allen and Paul Gilbert), turned traffic-counter data into reports.

name: Gautam Adani
current_role: Chairman, Adani Group (Ahmedabad; ports, airports, power, green energy, data centres)
best_contact: press_email: roy.paul@adani.com (Roy Paul, Adani Group Corporate Communication)
deep_cut_fact: As a teenager he left Ahmedabad for Mumbai (c.1978) and worked as a diamond sorter at Mahendra Brothers before setting up his own diamond brokerage in Zaveri Bazaar; he has recounted that his first deal, with a Japanese buyer, earned him a Rs 10,000 commission.

name: Henry Samueli
current_role: Cofounder and director, Broadcom Inc. (stepped down as chairman June 2026); owner of the NHL Anaheim Ducks; chairman, Samueli Foundation
deep_cut_fact: In 7th grade he talked his teacher into letting him build a five-tube radio kit (a ninth-grade project) instead of a crystal set; decades later he tracked down the same kit, a Graymark 506B, on eBay and built it again.

name: Henry Nicholas III
current_role: Co-founder and former CEO of Broadcom; founder of the Henry T. Nicholas, III Foundation and backer of Marsy's Law for All
best_contact: pr_agency: Ted Varipatis, Serra Public Affairs - ted@serrapublicaffairs.com (press contact listed for Marsy's Law campaign)
deep_cut_fact: In 2008 he co-founded the Nicholas Academic Centers with retired Orange County Superior Court Judge Jack K. Mandel to give academic support to under-resourced Santa Ana high schoolers; he has given $57.7M and the centers have graduated 2,070 students, nearly all going on to post-secondary education.

name: Philip Anschutz
current_role: Owner, Chairman and CEO, The Anschutz Corporation (Denver); owner of Anschutz Entertainment Group (AEG)
deep_cut_fact: His early oil career was saved by Hollywood: when his Wyoming well near Gillette caught fire in the late 1960s, he sold Universal Studios exclusive rights to film the blaze for its John Wayne/Red Adair movie 'Hellfighters' for $100,000, which paid Adair to put it out.

name: Huang Shilin
current_role: Co-founder and ~9-10% shareholder of CATL (left vice-chair/board in Aug 2022); reported chairman of Contemporary Nebula Technology Energy (CNTE, Fujian)
deep_cut_fact: He and CATL chairman Robin Zeng (Zeng Yuqun) were high-school classmates; a Hefei University of Technology graduate, Huang was R&D director at Dongguan ATL (Amperex) and Ningde ATL before co-founding CATL.

name: Harold Hamm
current_role: Founder & Executive Chairman, Continental Resources (private since 2022); founder of the Hamm Institute for American Energy at Oklahoma State University
deep_cut_fact: Hamm started work at 16 at a gas station, then mucked out oil tanks at a refinery. He founded his first company, Shelly Dean Oil Co. (later Continental), in 1967, and went back to finish college at Phillips University in Enid only after he struck oil.

name: Jason Chang
current_role: Chairman (and CEO per company releases), ASE Technology Holding Co. (TWSE: 3711, NYSE: ASX)
deep_cut_fact: Trained as an engineer: electronics engineering degree from National Taiwan University and an M.S. in industrial engineering from the Illinois Institute of Technology; National Cheng Kung University gave him an honorary doctorate in July 2022 (ASE and NCKU have collaborated on packaging R&D since 2012).

name: Sarath Ratanavadi
current_role: Founder and CEO, Gulf Development PCL (Thailand)
deep_cut_fact: A keen golfer and former managing director of the Thailand Golf Championship, he opened Stonehill, a 340+ acre private golf club outside Bangkok designed by architect Kyle Phillips, in 2022.

name: George Kaiser
current_role: President/CEO and primary owner of GBK Corp (parent of Kaiser-Francis Oil); chairman and majority owner of BOK Financial; founder, George Kaiser Family Foundation
deep_cut_fact: His foundation, jointly with the University of Tulsa, acquired Bob Dylan's 6,000+ item archive in 2016 (reportedly $15-20m), after earlier buying the Woody Guthrie archive; both now anchor Tulsa's Brady Arts District (Bob Dylan Center, Woody Guthrie Center).

name: Lu Xiangyang
current_role: Vice chairman, BYD Company; chairman of Youngy Group (融捷集团) and chairman/president of listed Youngy Co., Ltd. (002192.SZ)
deep_cut_fact: Through Youngy Co. (融捷股份), which he chairs, Lu controls Rongda Lithium, holder of the mining right to the No. 134 spodumene vein at Jiajika in Kangding, Sichuan, one of China's largest hard-rock lithium deposits. In 2024 it agreed a project to add 350,000 t/yr of ore-processing capacity at the mine.

name: Andrew Forrest
current_role: Founder and Executive Chairman, Fortescue; chair of Minderoo Foundation; owner of Squadron Energy
deep_cut_fact: In 2019 he earned a PhD in marine science from the University of Western Australia (he is now an adjunct research fellow at its Oceans Institute). He also converted his 58m superyacht Pangaea into a Minderoo ocean-research vessel with on-board labs.

name: Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud
current_role: King of Saudi Arabia and Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques (since January 2015)
deep_cut_fact: He is a keen amateur historian: he long chaired Darah (the King Abdulaziz Foundation for Research and Archives), and his personal library is known for its rare manuscripts and books on Arabian history.

name: George Roberts
current_role: Co-Founder and Co-Executive Chairman, KKR & Co. Inc.
deep_cut_fact: Roberts graduated from Culver Military Academy in Indiana in 1962 and received its 'Man of the Year' award in 1998. He became a Bear Stearns partner at 29. He also founded REDF in 1997 (originally the Roberts Enterprise Development Fund), an early backer of employment social enterprises; he still chairs its board.

name: Michael Sabel
current_role: CEO and Executive Co-Chairman, Venture Global (NYSE: VG), Arlington, Virginia
deep_cut_fact: Before LNG, Sabel and Pender tried in 2009 to develop a coal power plant in Sri Lanka; it didn't happen, and the LNG idea came while studying how Haiti could import small volumes of gas.

name: Robert Pender
current_role: Co-founder and Executive Co-Chairman, Venture Global, Inc. (NYSE: VG)
deep_cut_fact: Pro bono, he gave legal support to the Interim Haiti Recovery Commission and then served as a counselor to Haiti's Minister Delegate for Energy Security. He also helped the American Red Cross with South Asia tsunami relief and Accion with microfinance projects in Africa.

name: Haji Hassanal Bolkiah
current_role: Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan of Brunei Darussalam; also Prime Minister, Defence, Finance and Foreign Minister
deep_cut_fact: He is a qualified pilot who flies his own aircraft: in March 2013 he personally piloted his Boeing 747 to Washington for his meeting with President Obama.

name: Richard Kinder
current_role: Executive Chairman and co-founder, Kinder Morgan, Inc.; Chairman, Kinder Foundation
deep_cut_fact: A University of Missouri BA/JD alumnus (and Sigma Nu), he funded Mizzou's Kinder Institute on Constitutional Democracy with $25M in 2015, later raising total giving to the institute to $60M. Houston's Kinder Land Bridge over Memorial Drive in Memorial Park (2023) is also named for him and Nancy.

name: Henry Kravis
current_role: Co-Executive Chairman, KKR & Co. Inc.
deep_cut_fact: Born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, the son of an oil-industry engineer, Kravis captained the Claremont Men's College golf team as a senior in 1967, finishing his last season with an undefeated conference record; CMC's Kravis Center and Kravis Leadership Institute bear his name.

name: Carrie Perrodo
current_role: Owner (with family) of Perenco, the family-owned Anglo-French oil & gas producer; son François Perrodo is chairman
best_contact: pr_agency: Celicourt (Mark Antelme) – perenco@celicourt.uk (Perenco media enquiries)
deep_cut_fact: Her Chinese name is 黃嘉兒; she was born in Hong Kong and moved to Singapore to pursue modelling before founding Carrie's Models. Her late husband Hubert was also a polo player and noted art collector.

name: Randa Duncan Williams
current_role: Non-executive Chairman, Enterprise Products Partners (general partner) and Chairman of EPCO / Enterprise Products Company
best_contact: press_email: rrainey@eprod.com (Rick Rainey, Media Relations, Enterprise Products; tel (713) 381-3635)
deep_cut_fact: A Houston Museum of Natural Science trustee since 1995 and former board chair, she also served on the board of the Manned Space Flight Education Foundation (the nonprofit behind Space Center Houston).

name: Tsai Ming-kai
current_role: Chairman, MediaTek Inc. (Taiwan fabless chip designer)
deep_cut_fact: Before UMC he spent seven years as an IC design manager at ITRI's Electronics Research & Service Organization (ERSO), the government lab that seeded Taiwan's chip industry; he holds an MSEE from the University of Cincinnati.

name: Karel Komarek
current_role: Founder and Chairman of the Board, KKCG (owner of Allwyn, MND, Aricoma)
deep_cut_fact: He co-founded 'More than Equal' with ex-F1 driver David Coulthard, a non-profit aiming to find and develop Formula 1's first female world champion; he also backs American Racing Challenger Team USA sailing with Ken Read.

name: Low Tuck Kwong
current_role: Founder and President Director, PT Bayan Resources Tbk (Indonesia)
deep_cut_fact: In 2023 the Low Tuck Kwong Foundation gave S$127.6 million to education and healthcare causes, making it the largest private giver among all of Singapore's philanthropic organisations that year.

name: Daniel Kretinsky
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, EP Group / Energetický a průmyslový holding (EPH); chairman of Royal Mail parent IDS; chairman of AC Sparta Prague
deep_cut_fact: In a rare 2015 public lecture at Prague's University of Economics (VŠE) - 3,000+ wanted in, ~350 got seats - he told students that 'authentic interest', not the desire to succeed, is what leads to success, and advised staying 'as close as possible to the owner of capital'. He said he made his first million at 24.

name: Kelcy Warren
current_role: Executive Chairman, Energy Transfer LP (Dallas)
deep_cut_fact: A serious music fan, Warren co-founded the independent Texas roots/Americana label Music Road Records in 2007 with singer-songwriter Jimmy LaFave and Fred Remmert, and collects music memorabilia (e.g. Eagles-signed drumsticks). He holds a 1978 civil-engineering degree from UT Arlington.

name: Pavel Tykac
current_role: Owner, Sev.en Global Investments / Sev.en Group (coal, power, steel, oil & gas; Prague)
deep_cut_fact: He is a native of Čelákovice, a small town near Prague, and Forbes Czech names his real passion as football club SK Slavia Prague, which it lists among his holdings.

name: Ray Lee Hunt
current_role: Chairman Emeritus, Hunt Consolidated, Inc. (Dallas; oil & gas, LNG, real estate, investments)
deep_cut_fact: Hunt and John Scovell were 20-somethings who 'didn't know rebar from structural steel' when they started the Reunion project in 1972; Hunt made Scovell president of Woodbine Development as its only employee, and at 32 refused even to read the $35M construction contract, trusting him. Reunion Tower opened April 15, 1978.

name: Michael Kadoorie
current_role: Non-executive Chairman, CLP Holdings; Non-executive Chairman, The Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels (Peninsula Hotels)
best_contact: press_email: justine.lau@clp.com.hk (CLP media contact; media hotline +852 7306 2525)
deep_cut_fact: He is a helicopter pilot: Heliservices (HK) was founded in 1978 after he bought Hong Kong's first private helicopter. He still chairs it, and it flies from the Peninsula's rooftop helipad and washes power-line insulators for HK utilities.

name: Rinat Akhmetov
current_role: Founder and owner, System Capital Management (SCM) group (Metinvest, DTEK); president of FC Shakhtar Donetsk
deep_cut_fact: His 'Heart of Azovstal' project began with a call to Azovstal commander Denys Prokopenko 15 minutes before the defenders left the plant. Prokopenko asked him to 'take care of my men', and Akhmetov launched the project in January 2023 with $25M for Mariupol defenders and families of fallen soldiers.

name: Tench Coxe
current_role: Director, NVIDIA (since 1993; audit and compensation committees); former Managing Director, Sutter Hill Ventures
deep_cut_fact: Before venture capital he was Director of Marketing and MIS at Digital Communication Associates; he holds an economics BA from Dartmouth and a Harvard MBA. In 2025 he also became a minority owner of MLS club Austin FC.

name: John Catsimatidis
current_role: Owner, Chairman and CEO, Red Apple Group (Gristedes/D'Agostino, United Refining, WABC radio); director, Turning Point Brands
deep_cut_fact: Before oil he dabbled in aviation: he invested in charter carrier Capitol Air in 1984 and in 1992 launched his own charter airline, Capitol Air Express, which flew from 1993 to 1996 in the old Capitol Air livery. He studied electrical engineering at NYU (Brooklyn Tech '66) before quitting 8 credits short.

name: Trevor Rees-Jones
current_role: Founder, Chief Oil & Gas (Dallas); co-founder of The Rees-Jones Foundation
deep_cut_fact: He earned Eagle Scout with Troop 70 in 1966, and the Circle Ten Council's Trevor Rees-Jones Scout Camp is named after him; his foundation also funded the Rees-Jones Foundation Leadership Veranda at the Boy Scouts' Summit Bechtel Reserve.

name: Paul Foster
current_role: Founder & CEO, Franklin Mountain Investments (El Paso, TX); former founder/chairman of Western Refining
deep_cut_fact: Raised in Lovington, New Mexico (class of 1975), he earned an accounting degree from Baylor in 1979 and then started out working at the local refinery back in Lovington before moving to El Paso.

name: Alejandro Bulgheroni
current_role: Chairman, Pan American Energy Group (Argentina); owner of Bulgheroni family wine estates incl. Bodega Garzón (Uruguay)
deep_cut_fact: His wine empire began as an energy idea: in 2006 he stood on a windy Uruguayan hilltop scouting a wind-farm site, advisers suggested vines instead, and when told quality would take 6-8 years he quipped, 'How old do you think I am?' (Wine Spectator, 2018).

name: Fernand Huts
current_role: Chairman and owner, Katoen Natie (KN Holding, Luxembourg/Antwerp); controlling owner of waste-to-energy group Indaver
deep_cut_fact: His first company, Het Veldboerke, sold organically grown vegetables and fruit long before organic was mainstream. As Trends' 1987 'Manager of the Year', he said his managers should not read management books but go out for beers. He is also an occasional DJ.

name: Otto Toto Sugiri
current_role: Cofounder and President Director (CEO), PT DCI Indonesia Tbk
deep_cut_fact: In 1999 he founded Balicamp (PT Sigma Karya Sempurna), an export-oriented software development campus in Pacung village, Bali, meant to let young Indonesian programmers compete internationally.

name: Yeow Chor
current_role: Group Managing Director and Chief Executive, IOI Corporation Berhad (Malaysia); Chairman, Malaysian Palm Oil Association
deep_cut_fact: Before joining the family business he spent four years (1990-94) in Malaysia's Attorney General's Chambers and the judiciary, and his last posting was as a magistrate.

name: Lynn Schusterman
current_role: Co-Founder and Chair Emerita, Charles and Lynn Schusterman Family Philanthropies (Tulsa)
deep_cut_fact: She began volunteering with the National Council of Jewish Women in the early 1960s; after Charles died in 2000 she became the first woman to lead a large Jewish philanthropic organization, and in 1994 she helped found Hillel in the former Soviet Union.

name: Theodore Rachmat
current_role: Founder, Triputra Group; Vice President Commissioner, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia (formerly Adaro Energy)
deep_cut_fact: He started at Astra in June 1968 as a heavy-equipment salesman after being called in by William Soeryadjaya; his Yayasan Pelayanan Kasih A&A Rachmat has funded scholarships for thousands of undergraduates and supports 120 orphanages.

name: Meg Whitman
current_role: Board director, CoreWeave (since March 2025); former U.S. Ambassador to Kenya (2022-2024)
best_contact: press_email: press@coreweave.com (CoreWeave, where she is a director)
deep_cut_fact: She entered Princeton planning to be a doctor but switched to economics after a summer selling ads for the student magazine Business Today; later, as head of Hasbro's Playskool division (1997), she brought the UK's Teletubbies to American TV.

name: Chey Tae-won
current_role: Chairman, SK Group (SK Inc.); Chairman, Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry
deep_cut_fact: He holds a physics degree from Korea University, completed the economics PhD program at the University of Chicago, co-authored a 2019 Stanford business case on SK's Double Bottom Line, and has twice been elected President of the Korea Handball Federation.

name: Ray Davis
current_role: Managing Partner, Majority Owner and Board Chairman, Texas Rangers; Chairman & CEO, Avatar Investments L.P.
deep_cut_fact: He received the Navy SEAL Foundation's 'Fire in the Gut' Award in 2024 and the BENS Eisenhower Award in 2017; his listed interests are ranching, bird hunting and reading.

name: Francois Perrodo
current_role: Chairman, Perenco (Franco-British independent oil & gas producer)
deep_cut_fact: He read physics at St Peter's College, Oxford, where he captained the University polo team in 1999, then earned an engineering degree from the French petroleum school IFP School (2002) and an INSEAD MBA in Singapore, his birthplace.

name: Saban Cemil Kazanci
current_role: Chairman & CEO, Kazancı Holding; Chairman, Aksa Energy and Aksa Electricity
deep_cut_fact: He has been awarded Uzbekistan's Order of Friendship (Dustlik), recognising Aksa's power-plant investments there.

name: GM Rao
current_role: Founder Chairman, GMR Group (infrastructure: airports, energy, highways, urban development)
deep_cut_fact: Before going into business he worked as a shift engineer at a paper mill and then as a junior engineer in the Andhra Pradesh Public Works Department; he moved into commodities trading at his mother's insistence.

name: Erramon Aboitiz
current_role: Director, Aboitiz Equity Ventures; Chairman, Union Bank of the Philippines; Chairman of the Board of Trustees, Asian Institute of Management
deep_cut_fact: He studied in the US Pacific Northwest, earning a BS in Business Administration (Accounting and Finance) from Gonzaga University in Spokane, Washington; in 2023 he became only the 7th chairman of the Asian Institute of Management, succeeding Peter Garrucho.

name: Michael Intrator
current_role: Co-founder, Chairman and CEO, CoreWeave, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRWV)
deep_cut_fact: Before natural-gas trading and AI, he spent years at Natsource Asset Management working in environmental/carbon markets, and he holds an MPA from Columbia SIPA (plus a BA from Binghamton). He received the Research & Development Council of New Jersey's Science & Technology Medal.

name: Arvind Tiku
current_role: Founder & Chairman, AT Group / AT Capital (Singapore); Chairman & founder, Juniper Green Energy
deep_cut_fact: Tiku stresses Juniper's hybrid strategy: he has said about 83% of its portfolio is wind, wind-solar hybrid and firm-and-dispatchable (FDRE) projects and only ~17% plain solar, which management says earns better tariffs.

name: Mário Araripe
current_role: Founder and majority owner, Casa dos Ventos (shares leadership with CEO Lucas Araripe)
deep_cut_fact: Born in Crato, Ceará, son of an engineer in Brazil's federal anti-drought works department; he trained as an aeronautical-mechanical engineer at ITA. The wind idea came from ITA classmate Odilon Camargo, who urged him to be first to map Brazil's wind potential; he then used the Troller sale cash to prospect the Northeast.

name: Lisa Su
current_role: Chair, President and CEO, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD)
deep_cut_fact: As an MIT freshman her UROP job was 'pure grunt work' making two-inch wafers in Hank Smith's semiconductor lab in Building 39 for x-ray lithography research; that plus summer jobs at Analog Devices hooked her on semiconductors. Her PhD was among the earliest work on silicon-on-insulator (SOI).

name: Michael S. Smith
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Freeport LNG (Houston); director, Teledyne Technologies
deep_cut_fact: Though he left CSU just shy of a chemistry degree, his 2016 $13M gift to Colorado State created 50 full-tuition business scholarships for the college's 50th anniversary and completed funding for the Michael Smith Natural Resources Building; he credited 'strong science and mathematics' at CSU for teaching him the oil business.

name: Garibaldi Thohir
current_role: Vice President Commissioner, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (formerly Adaro Energy; stepped down as President Director at the June 2025 AGM)
deep_cut_fact: Back from his US MBA, he wanted a $2,000-a-month job at Citibank, but his father refused and told him to be an entrepreneur. His first venture (1991) was a plan to build a rental office on a 3,000 m2 plot along the new Saharjo-Kuningan road in Jakarta; it stalled because land clearances required at least 1 hectare.

name: Andre Desmarais
current_role: Deputy Chairman, Power Corporation of Canada and Power Financial Corporation
best_contact: press_email: Media requests: Stéphane Lemay, VP, General Counsel & Secretary, Power Corporation of Canada (phone listed on contact page; no email published)
deep_cut_fact: He started his career at Campeau Corporation in 1979 and was a special assistant to Canada's Minister of Justice in 1980-81 before joining Power Corp in 1983. He also started and owned an experimental farm in Canada.

name: Surender Pal Singh Saluja
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Premier Energies Ltd (Hyderabad solar cell & module maker; listed NSE/BSE 2024)
best_contact: press_email: mohit.chawla@premierenergies.com (Mohit Chawla, Marketing & Communications, Premier Energies)
deep_cut_fact: He graduated in mechanical engineering from Karnatak University, Dharwad, in 1969 and ran small ventures before solar; he has said his one slight regret is never having worked as an employee at a corporation early in his career.

name: Marina Budiman
current_role: Co-founder & President Commissioner, PT DCI Indonesia Tbk (DCII)
deep_cut_fact: She has no tech degree (University of Toronto, finance/economics) and planned to be a banker; a 1985 software-installation project at Bank Bali convinced her tech could power business. Her line: 'You will never get bored with the tech sector.'

name: Jamie Augusto Zobel de Ayala
current_role: Chairman, Ayala Corporation (Philippines); also chairs BPI and ACEN (formerly AC Energy)
deep_cut_fact: A rugby devotee who played county-level rugby in Sussex as a teen at English boarding school, he flew to France for the 2007 World Cup to cheer the All Blacks; at Harvard he rowed lightweight crew briefly and calls quitting 'one of my big regrets.'

name: Adebayo Ogunlesi
current_role: Chairman & CEO, Global Infrastructure Partners (a part of BlackRock); Senior Managing Director, BlackRock; OpenAI board member
deep_cut_fact: Alongside his dealmaking he has taught courses on transnational investment projects at Harvard Law School, Yale Law School and the Yale School of Management.

name: F.C. Tseng
current_role: Director, TSMC (board member since 1997); Chairman, TSMC China and TSMC Education & Culture Foundation; Vice Chairman, Vanguard International Semiconductor
deep_cut_fact: In 1976 ITRI sent him, with Shih Chin-tai and Robert Tsao, to RCA in the US for CMOS IC training: part of the first group of Taiwanese engineers to acquire integrated-circuit technology, seen as the spark of Taiwan's chip industry.

name: Michael Polsky
current_role: Founder and CEO, Invenergy (Chicago)
deep_cut_fact: He arrived in the US with $500, four suitcases and no English, mailed his résumé to hundreds of companies he found in library directories, and won his first job, an engineering post at Bechtel, by communicating through math equations and sketches.

name: Li Zhenguo
current_role: Founder, LONGi Green Energy Technology; President of its Central R&D Institute and CTO (stepped down as director/GM in May 2025)
deep_cut_fact: His first job after graduating in 1990 was at the Huashan Semiconductor Materials Factory; he later ran the crystal base of a Xi'an University of Technology factory before founding LONGi, which started out supplying reprocessed silicon rather than solar products.

name: Kenneth Hao
current_role: Managing Partner and Co-Chairman, Silver Lake; director of Broadcom and Altera
deep_cut_fact: He played on the tennis team at Harvard College (A.B. Economics) and today sits on the board of UTR Sports, the Universal Tennis Rating company, as well as the Metropolitan Museum of Art and UCSF.

name: Kamal Ghaffarian
current_role: Founder and executive chairman of X-energy (XE), Intuitive Machines (LUNR), Axiom Space and Quantum Space
deep_cut_fact: At Capitol Technology University's May 2026 commencement (his alma mater: BS 1983, PhD 2022) he handed every graduate a gold envelope with $1,500, saying it was inspired by the family support he got after immigrating. Watching Apollo 11 on TV as a boy in Iran sparked his space passion.

name: Brian Venturo
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer, CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV)
deep_cut_fact: The first mining rigs sat on the pool table in the founders' Manhattan office, then moved to a closet, and then, as Venturo joked, to 'the most cliche place possible' - his grandfather's garage in New Jersey. He also recalls 'literally pounding on the dinner table' to win Magnetar's first $100M check.

name: Zygmunt Solorz
current_role: Founder and controlling shareholder, Polsat Plus Group (Cyfrowy Polsat) and power producer ZE PAK
deep_cut_fact: In 2019 his lignite power producer ZE PAK began working with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power on possible small modular reactors at the Pątnów power station site, part of the group's move from coal to nuclear and renewables.

name: Mika Anttonen
current_role: Founder, principal owner and Chairman of the Board, St1 (St1 Oy, formerly St1 Nordic Oy), Finland
deep_cut_fact: He has a Master's in engineering and likes to say 'I is a bad pronoun. We is much better.' He has argued that educating girls and women in developing nations would be the single most significant climate action (Aalto University interview, 2018).

name: Manoj Upadhyay
current_role: Founder, Chairman and Managing Director, ACME Solar Holdings Ltd (Gurugram)
deep_cut_fact: After selling his stake in his first venture, lightning-protection firm Adhunik Power Systems, for Rs 20 lakh, he designed ACME's Power Interface Unit for Bharti Airtel's diesel-plagued cell towers in 17 days - 12 of them without sleep - lifting tower uptime to ~97%.

name: Henry Sy Jr
current_role: Chairperson, SM Prime Holdings; Vice Chairman, SM Investments Corporation; Vice Chairman, National Grid Corporation of the Philippines
best_contact: press_email: smic_corpcomm@sminvestments.com (SM Investments corporate communications / IR)
deep_cut_fact: In business circles he is nicknamed 'Big Boy' as the founder's eldest son; like his brothers he graduated from De La Salle University and, per family lore, the Sy children were raised inside the family firm from a young age.

name: Shao Danwei
current_role: Founder, executive director and CEO, Wanbang Digital Energy (Star Charge / 星星充电), Changzhou; chairman since Dec 2017
deep_cut_fact: She says Star Charge began after an August 2014 dinner in Laoshan with TELD chairman Yu Dexiang: she wanted to buy his chargers, his quote was too high, so she built her own - joking in 2024, 'If you had given me a cheaper price, there would be no runner-up today.'

name: Folorunsho Alakija
current_role: Executive Vice Chairman, Famfa Oil Ltd; Group Managing Director, Rose of Sharon Group
deep_cut_fact: Her career began in 1974 as an executive secretary at Sijuade Enterprises in Lagos after secretarial studies at Pitman Central College, London; she later served as president of the Fashion Designers Association of Nigeria and remains a trustee.

name: Jean Claude Gandur
current_role: Founder & Chairman, AOG (Addax & Oryx Group, owner of Oryx Energies); Founder, Fondation Gandur pour l'Art
deep_cut_fact: He grew up in Alexandria, Egypt until age 12, studied law and political science at Lausanne and history at the Sorbonne, and started in 1976 at commodities trader Philipp Brothers (Phibro), spending eight years at its Zug subsidiary before founding AOG.

name: Alexander Knaster
current_role: Founder, Pamplona Capital Management (London); majority owner of Pisa SC; founder of The Mark Foundation for Cancer Research
best_contact: pr_agency: ed.orlebar@tbcardew.com (Tavistock/TB Cardew - media enquiries for Pamplona)
deep_cut_fact: Energy roots: in 1980, fresh out of Carnegie Mellon, he took a job as an engineer with Schlumberger working on oil platforms in the Gulf of Mexico. He later endowed the Alexander M. Knaster Scholarship Fund (1993) for CMU electrical & computer engineering undergrads.

name: Stefan Fuch
current_role: CEO (Chairman of the Executive Board), FUCHS SE, Mannheim (contract extended to June 2029)
deep_cut_fact: Before joining the family firm he spent two years as an auditing assistant at Wollert-Elmendorff Deutsche Industrie-Treuhand in Mannheim, then was posted (1997-99) to Fuchs Lubricants Co. in Harvey, Illinois, responsible for Argentina, Brazil and Mexico. He also sits on the supervisory board of machine-tool maker TRUMPF.

name: Robin Khuda
current_role: Founder and CEO, AirTrunk
deep_cut_fact: Right before founding AirTrunk he left NEXTDC to become CEO of Mint Wireless, a telecom payments company; he says he had been watching the cloud boom since 2010-11 and planning his own data-center business.

name: Farris Wilks
current_role: Co-owner, Wilks Brothers LLC (family investment office, Cisco, Texas); 10%+ shareholder in ProFrac Holding Corp. (ACDC)
deep_cut_fact: Before oil, the brothers were bricklayers like their father and ran Wilks Masonry; they launched Frac Tech in 2002 out of tiny Cisco, Texas (Eastland County), where both still live, and grew it into one of the largest US fracking firms in under a decade.

name: Brad Keywell
current_role: Founder & Executive Chairman, Gigawatt AI (AI-native operating system for utilities, founded Aug 2025); Director, TKO Group Holdings
deep_cut_fact: He started his first business at age 7, a greeting-card company called Key Creations. As a University of Michigan freshman he met Sam Zell and spent summers interning at Zell's Equity Group Investments; Zell mentored him for 35 years. He is also an adjunct professor of entrepreneurship at Chicago Booth.

name: Timothy Dunn
current_role: CEO, CrownQuest Operating (Midland, Texas)
deep_cut_fact: He played lead guitar in a rock band from high school through Texas Tech, says making Eagle Scout is the early achievement he is proudest of, and scrapped plans for law school to take a job at Exxon Production Research, which sent him to the Middle East three times.

name: Brannin McBee
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Development Officer, CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV)
deep_cut_fact: Before CoreWeave he was a proprietary trader in North American natural gas and power markets (Windy Bay Power, 2013-2018; Active Power Investments, focused on natural gas, power and agriculture). He received the Research & Development Council of New Jersey's Science & Technology Medal (2026 Edison Patent Awards).

name: Sanjay Gajendra
current_role: Co-founder, President and COO, Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB)
deep_cut_fact: Before Astera he ran TI's High Speed Interface business (signal conditioning chips) and holds a master's in engineering management from the University of Colorado Boulder.

name: Jitendra Mohan
current_role: Co-founder, CEO and director, Astera Labs (Nasdaq: ALAB)
deep_cut_fact: An IIT Bombay electrical engineering grad (B.Tech 1994) with a Stanford MS, he spent nearly 16 years (1996-2012) at National Semiconductor, rising through technical roles to Design Director before joining TI.

name: D.V. Manjunatha
current_role: Chairman & Managing Director, Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd (Bengaluru; listed on NSE/BSE Nov 2025)
deep_cut_fact: Before PV, Emmvee's Solarizer solar water heater became, by the company's account, the largest such brand in India; he personally received the Sourya Urja Bhushan Award in 2015 and a Business Leadership Excellence Award at Suryacon 2020.

name: Julien Chaumond
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Hugging Face (being acquired by Nvidia)
deep_cut_fact: His own Hugging Face profile lists his personal AI hardware: two RTX 3090s, an Nvidia GB10 (DGX Spark-class) box, an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 machine and an Apple M5 Max with 128GB as his primary rig.

name: Evangelos Mytilineos
current_role: Chairman and CEO, METLEN Energy & Metals (Athens/London-listed)
deep_cut_fact: A Moraitis School alumnus, he holds an economics BSc from the University of Athens and an MSc from the London School of Economics; the University of Piraeus gave him an honorary doctorate in 2019, and his family hails from Koroni in the Peloponnese.

name: Harvey Jones
current_role: Managing Partner, Square Wave Ventures; NVIDIA director since 1993 (Nvidia's board page lists him as Chair of the Board, plus audit and nominating/governance committees)
deep_cut_fact: In high school he discovered a teletype link to a timesharing system, taught himself BASIC, and 'sold my chemistry homework to my classmates' - his first entrepreneurial exercise. He then nearly took an IBM job on Allegheny Airlines' reservations system before joining CAD firm Calma.

name: Dean Solon
current_role: Founder, CEO & President, Create Energy (Portland, Tennessee); founder of Shoals Technologies Group
deep_cut_fact: Shoals began making auto parts for Bosch; when Bosch wanted suppliers to move to Mexico after NAFTA he refused to leave Tennessee, and his first solar customer was an upstart First Solar needing junction boxes. Despite billionaire status he says he still drives a 2017 Chevy Bolt.

name: Chris Lin
current_role: Chairman and President, ASPEED Technology (Taiwan; TPEx: 5274)
deep_cut_fact: Lin has quantified the AI effect on his niche: he said an Nvidia GB200 NVL72 rack uses 87 BMCs versus 12 in an H100-based rack. At Computex 2026 he said ASPEED's constraint was supply-chain capacity, not orders.

name: Pantas Sutardja
current_role: Director, Credo Technology Group (Nasdaq: CRDO); founder & CEO of LatticeWork.
deep_cut_fact: Drawing on his IBM hard-drive work, Pantas defined the architecture of Marvell's first all-CMOS read-channel chip. Designed for 180 Mb/s, it was already running near 240 Mb/s when Seagate asked for 240 - Seagate became Marvell's first customer. As boys in Singapore he and Sehat built a Van de Graaff generator from surplus copper wire.

name: Ignacio Torras
current_role: Founder and CEO, Tricon Energy (Houston)
deep_cut_fact: His restaurants began on a 2008 family holiday: renting a house in Fonteta, Spain, he met its house chef Luis Roger and recruited him to Houston. Their restaurants BCN and MAD are named after the Barcelona and Madrid airport codes.

name: Peter Livanos
current_role: Chairman, GasLog Ltd (LNG shipping) and head of the family-owned Ceres Shipping / Ceres Hellenic Shipping Enterprises
deep_cut_fact: He is an engineer by training, with a B.S. from Columbia University's engineering school (1981) after the Buckley School and Le Rosey. The Massachusetts Maritime Academy awarded him an honorary Doctorate of Science.

name: Robert Coyuito jr
current_role: President & COO, Oriental Petroleum and Minerals Corp.; Chairman & CEO, Prudential Guarantee and Assurance (PGA)
deep_cut_fact: In June 2017 President Duterte named him presidential adviser on capital market development.

name: Hock E. Tan
current_role: President and CEO, Broadcom Inc.; Director, Meta Platforms (since 2024)
deep_cut_fact: In 2015 he pledged $4M to MIT to endow the Nam P. Suh Professorship in mechanical engineering, honoring his former MIT professor (first holder: quantum-computing pioneer Seth Lloyd). He earned both his MIT BS and MS in mechanical engineering in 1975.

name: Charles Liang
current_role: Co-founder, Chairman, President and CEO, Super Micro Computer Inc. (Supermicro), San Jose
deep_cut_fact: Supermicro's green-computing push began in 2004 when Liang took his kids to see 'The Day After Tomorrow'; his back-of-envelope sum showed slightly more efficient server power supplies could save the output of 30 fossil-fuel plants, so Supermicro built its own.

name: Mohammed Al Barwani
current_role: Founder and Chairman, MB Holding Company LLC (Muscat, Oman)
deep_cut_fact: Before founding MB he spent a decade (1976-86) as a reservoir engineer at Petroleum Development Oman (the Shell/government JV); he studied at Miami University (Ohio), UT Austin (chemical engineering) and Heriot-Watt, which gave him an honorary doctorate in petroleum engineering in 2010.

name: Aluru Jagadish Prasad
current_role: Chairman and Managing Director, HBL Engineering Ltd (formerly HBL Power Systems), Hyderabad
deep_cut_fact: Before starting HBL he worked at the Administrative Staff College of India in Hyderabad; he holds a B.Tech from IIT Kharagpur, an MS in Management from MIT and a doctorate in international business from Columbia University (per HBL's 2023-24 annual report).

name: Joachim Goldbeck
current_role: CEO / managing director, GOLDBECK SOLAR GmbH (Hirschberg an der Bergstrasse); co-owner (~1/3) of the Goldbeck construction group
deep_cut_fact: Rather than joining the family construction business's management, he built his own solar company, which now also does O&M for battery storage, PPAs and agri-PV with dynamic trackers - and built an agri-PV park at its own Hirschberg headquarters; it works with Fraunhofer on research projects.

name: Jack Cogen
current_role: Private investor; early backer and director of CoreWeave from Sept 2017 until he chose not to stand for re-election at the June 8, 2026 annual meeting
deep_cut_fact: He chaired the International Emissions Trading Association (IETA) from 2008 to 2011 and remains an IETA Fellow; academically he holds an M.S. in Mathematics as well as an MBA from NYU, plus a B.A. from Rutgers.

name: Daniel Roberts
current_role: Co-Founder, Co-CEO and Director, IREN Ltd (Nasdaq: IREN)
deep_cut_fact: Daniel first bought bitcoin in 2013 at about US$1,000 and sold at US$500 ('What nonsense is this?'), then joined the Ethereum presale. Scouting sites for Iris Energy, the brothers backpacked through Europe, Iceland and the US, and still laugh about a scuzzy windowless New York hostel.

name: Hitesh Doshi
current_role: Chairman & Managing Director, Waaree Energies Ltd (NSE: WAAREEENER); head of the Waaree Group, Mumbai
deep_cut_fact: Born in Tunki, a village in Maharashtra, Doshi moved about 600 km to attend Shri Chinai College of Commerce and Economics in Mumbai in 1985. He borrowed Rs 5,000 (about $60) from a relative to trade hardware, electronics and instrument gauges, which paid his college fees (he told the Economic Times in 2014).

name: Colette Kress
current_role: Interim CEO (since 12 Nov 2026) and EVP & Chief Financial Officer, NVIDIA.
deep_cut_fact: Jensen Huang interviewed 22 candidates before hiring her; in her first week she asked how long he'd want her in the role and he answered, 'For as long as we shall live and death do us part.' She holds a finance B.Sc. from the University of Arizona and an MBA from SMU.

name: Michael Tojner
current_role: Founder/CEO, Montana Tech Components and Global Equity Partners (Vienna); chairman of supervisory board, Montana Aerospace; major shareholder of Varta
best_contact: office_email: office@gep.at (Global Equity Partners, his investment firm, Vienna)
deep_cut_fact: The son of a plumber, he made his first million schillings as a 20-year-old WU Vienna student selling ice cream: he talked a bank into a 300,000-schilling loan, won a concession at Schonbrunn Palace and ran carts there and at Kahlenberg, Laxenburg and Belvedere, selling up to 5,000 cones a day.

name: Kazim Turker
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Türkerler Holding (Ankara)
deep_cut_fact: The 'Kazım Türker Art Gallery' bears his name: opened in January 2018 at Dokuz Eylül University's Faculty of Fine Arts in İzmir, created jointly with the university through Türkerler's Mahall Bomonti İzmir real-estate project. Türkerler also won a best geothermal project award at the 2018 ICCI Energy Awards.

name: Anna Margaret Smedvig
current_role: Vice Chair, Smedvig Family Office (Stavanger); formerly chairman of London-based Smedvig Capital
deep_cut_fact: Before taking over the family investment arm she worked at luxury stationer Smythson, consumer private-equity firm L Catterton and EC Hambro Rabben; she holds an MA in Psychology and Business from the University of Edinburgh and lists fashion, film, architecture and design as interests.

name: David Capobianco
current_role: CEO & Managing Partner, Five Point Infrastructure (formerly Five Point Energy); Chairman of LandBridge (NYSE: LB) and PowerBridge
deep_cut_fact: Before Vulcan he worked in Salomon Brothers' Energy Corporate Finance Group and on the investment teams of Harvest Partners and Greenhill Capital Partners. He later chaired Vulcan Energy Corp. (formerly Plains Resources) and chaired the compensation committee of Plains All American Pipeline. Duke BA, Harvard MBA.

name: KR Sridhar
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE)
deep_cut_fact: He co-authored the 1997 Solid State Ionics paper 'Oxygen production on Mars using solid oxide electrolysis' (with B.T. Vaniman): a zirconia cell splitting Martian CO2 into oxygen. Bloom's fuel cell is essentially that Mars device run in reverse. Fortune named him one of five young innovators in 2000.

name: Ki-Won Choi
current_role: Chair, SK Happiness Foundation (SK Group's social-innovation foundation); also runs the Wooran Foundation (arts)
deep_cut_fact: She runs the Wooran Foundation, a culture-and-arts foundation in Seongsu-dong, Seoul, named after her late mother Park Gye-hee, former director of the Walkerhill Art Center.

name: Brooke Seawell
current_role: Venture Partner, New Enterprise Associates (NEA); director and audit committee chair of Nvidia, Tenable and GoodLeap
deep_cut_fact: He is an avid cyclist who has taken 24 cycling vacations around the world and logged century rides plus a double century and four Death Rides; he is also a trustee of his old high school in Bethesda, Maryland, where he and his wife helped build a new STEM center.

name: Sanjay Mehrotra
current_role: Chairman, President and CEO, Micron Technology (MU); director, CDW
deep_cut_fact: Supporting himself from 18, his first job at Berkeley was collecting dirty dishes in the International House dining room - he quit after a few days to grade homework. Later, in 1984, he was slated to be one of four Atmel co-founders with mentor George Perlegos, but stayed at Seeq out of loyalty.

name: Andrew Feldman
current_role: Co-founder, President and CEO, Cerebras Systems (Nasdaq: CBRS)
best_contact: pr_agency: pr@zmcommunications.com (ZM Communications, media contact on Cerebras press releases)
deep_cut_fact: Data-center energy was his theme long before AI: his prior startup SeaMicro was 'founded to dramatically reduce the power consumed by servers' - its microservers used about a quarter of the power and a sixth of the space of conventional servers - and AMD bought it in 2012 for ~$334M.

name: Rodney Lewis
current_role: Founder, President & CEO, Lewis Energy Group (San Antonio, Texas)
deep_cut_fact: He holds a BA in criminal justice from what is now Texas A&M International University in Laredo, paid $13,000 for his first well, and in 2014 received Webb County's 'Angel of Hope' award for providing Christmas gifts to needy children.

name: Ajay Puri
current_role: Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations, NVIDIA (still listed with this title on an Aug 2026 SEC Form 4)
deep_cut_fact: Before his 22 years at Sun, Puri worked in product development at Texas Instruments and in consulting at Booz Allen. He holds electrical engineering degrees from the University of Minnesota (BS) and Caltech (MS) as well as a Harvard MBA, so he is an engineer by training, not a career salesman.

name: Eddy Sugianto
current_role: President Commissioner, PT Prima Andalan Mandiri Tbk (IDX: MCOL, 'Mandiri Coal'); controlling shareholder of Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa (Mandiri Services)
deep_cut_fact: The group's mine traces back to a 1994 Coal Contract of Work (No. 08/PK/PTBA-MI/1994) for a 50,000-ha area in North Kalimantan; after revisions cut it to 9,240 ha, production only began in 2004, a decade later. He has been president commissioner of PAM since 2005.

name: Lee Chae-yoon
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Leeno Industrial (KOSDAQ: 058470), Busan
deep_cut_fact: A self-made engineer who kept studying: he finished Kwangsung (Kyeongsung) Engineering High School in 1969, founded Leeno in 1978, and earned his Dong-Eui University degree only in 1991, 13 years after starting the company. He later completed a KAIST executive programme.

name: Toby Neugebauer
current_role: Co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc. (FRMI); former CEO (left April 2026); co-owner of MLS club Austin FC
best_contact: pr_agency: Collected Strategies (Nick Lamplough / Dan Moore), 212-379-2072
deep_cut_fact: Outside energy, his philanthropy has focused on family formation in US inner cities, and abroad he has worked with orphanages in China and helped build and maintain schools in Rwanda and Zambia.

name: Muhammed Aziz Khan
current_role: Founder & Chairman, Summit Group (Bangladesh); based in Singapore
best_contact: office_email: enquiry@summitpowerinternational.com (Summit Power International, One Raffles Place, Singapore)
deep_cut_fact: Singapore's Prime Minister's Office awarded him the Public Service Medal (COVID-19) for financially helping Bangladeshi workers in Singapore during the pandemic; he and his wife were also the first Bangladeshis named UNICEF International Council members.

name: Cesar Maklary
current_role: Co-founder and President, Fluidstack (AI cloud / data-center builder, HQ New York)
deep_cut_fact: Before data centers he worked on aerodynamics for a Formula One team. He has explained Fluidstack's origin as matching PhD friends starved for compute with 'hardcore cloud gaming friends' whose rigs sat idle most of the week.

name: James Dacombe
current_role: Founder & CEO, Olix (OLIX Computing, London AI-inference chip startup); founder & CEO, CoMind (brain monitoring)
deep_cut_fact: He started programming apps and websites at 13 while at Ashville College in Harrogate, North Yorkshire, then became a Thiel Fellow. He told the Sunday Times in 2024: 'An advantage of starting my business so young was naivety... you just try a lot of things.'

name: Jamie Cox
current_role: Cofounder, Fluidstack (AI cloud / data-center builder, now HQ'd in New York)
deep_cut_fact: He was reading classics at Oxford when he met economics student Gary Wu; he dropped out in 2018 to become a Thiel Fellow, and in 2020 he and Wu started Treecard, a cashback card that funded tree planting, alongside Fluidstack.

name: Randal Nardone
current_role: Director and major shareholder, New Fortress Energy (Nasdaq: NFE); co-founder of Fortress Investment Group
deep_cut_fact: Before finance, Nardone was a partner and member of the executive committee at New York law firm Thacher Proffitt & Wood, then a principal at BlackRock Financial Management; he holds a BA from UConn and a JD from Boston University School of Law.

name: John Whittaker
current_role: Founder and controlling owner of The Peel Group (UK property, ports, energy and infrastructure). Wikipedia lists him as chairman; Place North West reports Mark Whitworth as group chair since 2023
best_contact: press_email: egreen@peel.co.uk / kholland@peel.co.uk (Peel Waters media enquiries, a Peel Group business)
deep_cut_fact: He was educated at Prior Park College, a Catholic boarding school in Bath, and considered becoming a priest before joining the family building business.

name: Bryan Sheffield
current_role: Co-founder and Managing Partner, Formentera Partners (Austin, TX)
deep_cut_fact: In 2019 he founded the Drop Shot Series, Austin's first professional tennis tournament series, with former world-ranked pro Christo van Rensburg. It grew into the ATX Open, a WTA 250 event and Austin's largest women's pro sporting event. He is also a co-owner of Austin FC.

name: Zeki Zorlu
current_role: Honorary Chair (board of management), Zorlu Holding; chairs various group textile, energy and property companies
deep_cut_fact: Before manufacturing, he took the family weaving trade into commerce by running the first Zorlu store, opened in Trabzon on the Black Sea; HQ moved to Istanbul in 1970 and he launched Korteks yarn in Bursa in 1976.

name: Nikhil V Merchant
current_role: Managing Director, Swan Corp Limited (formerly Swan Energy Ltd; BSE 503310 / NSE SWANCORP)
deep_cut_fact: His Swan LNG unit built an FSRU-based LNG terminal at Jafrabad, Gujarat, and took delivery of the first Indian-flagged Floating Storage and Regasification Unit, built by Hyundai Heavy Industries. Swan's realty arm also built Hyderabad's Technova Business Park, leased to Google.

name: Stephen Fitzpatrick
current_role: Founder and majority shareholder of OVO Energy; founder and major shareholder of eVTOL maker Vertical Aerospace (NYSE: EVTL)
deep_cut_fact: His first company, founded in 2001 straight after his finance master's at the University of Edinburgh, was The Rental Guide, a property-advertising business, years before OVO.

name: Templeton Richard
current_role: Retired former Chairman and CEO, Texas Instruments (retired as executive chairman Dec 31, 2025)
deep_cut_fact: The Templetons also gave a 'landmark' $20M gift to SMU's Lyle School of Engineering in 2023, following an earlier $2M endowed chair in electrical engineering and $5M for research.

name: Vinod Kumar Agarwal
current_role: Chairman & Managing Director, Agarwal Coal Corporation Pvt. Ltd. (Indore); Chairman, Emerald Developers
deep_cut_fact: Agarwal Coal built its own in-house digital analytics platform, 'Manthan', for real-time market intelligence from procurement to sales. The group aims to grow its solar portfolio to 100-150 MW.

name: Farukbhai Gulambhai Patel
current_role: Founder, Chairman & Managing Director, KP Group (KPI Green Energy, KP Energy, KP Green Engineering), Surat, Gujarat
deep_cut_fact: Before renewables he is credited with the 'one tower, multiple networks' telecom-tower sharing idea, and KP was the first to install wind turbines in South Gujarat after three years of research; his group is also building what it calls the world's first old-age home for differently-abled people.

name: Peter Salanki
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer, CoreWeave (Nasdaq: CRWV)
deep_cut_fact: Right before CoreWeave (Jan 2018-Jun 2019) he was Director, Americas in the Office of the CTO at Sandvine, a network-intelligence/deep-packet-inspection company - a networking background that predates his GPU-cloud work.

name: Zhang Wen
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Shanghai Biren Technology (壁仞科技, HKEX: 6082)
deep_cut_fact: Biren says it ranks first among Chinese general-purpose GPU makers for granted patents (1,006 granted of 1,917 applications by mid-2026), and its core GPU patent won a 2026 China Patent Silver Award.

name: Lim Chai Hock
current_role: Director & Chief Operating Officer, PT Bayan Resources Tbk (Indonesia)
deep_cut_fact: His formal training is in land surveying: after his 1977 Malaysian Certificate of Education he earned a Certificate in Land Surveying in 1981 from Lembaga Jabatan Ukur, Peninsular Malaysia - a surveyor who became a coal billionaire.

name: Sean Lie
current_role: Co-founder & Chief Technology Officer, Cerebras Systems (Nasdaq: CBRS)
deep_cut_fact: Before Cerebras, Lie was a microprocessor architect on AMD's advanced architecture team (2004-08). At SeaMicro he was lead hardware architect of the IO-virtualization fabric ASIC that linked hundreds of tiny CPUs in its dense servers, and after AMD bought SeaMicro he was Chief Architect for Data Center Server Solutions.

name: Caroline Cochran
current_role: Co-founder, Chief Operating Officer and Director, Oklo Inc. (NYSE: OKLO)
deep_cut_fact: She started out as a climate-concerned nuclear skeptic. She holds a BA in economics and a BS in mechanical engineering from the University of Oklahoma, where she later helped set up a technology-commercialization program, and she is one of the youngest recipients of OU's Regents' Alumni Award.

name: Jeffrey Henley
current_role: Executive Vice Chair of the Board, Oracle Corporation; Chair, Institute for Energy Efficiency, UC Santa Barbara
deep_cut_fact: Oracle recruited him in 1991 for his reputation as a turnaround CFO; he calls Oracle 'the biggest turnaround, financially, of anything I'd done before.' At UCSB ('66) he cut his teeth as treasurer of the SigEp chapter, and he advises: 'If you think you want to be a CFO, you can't wait until you're 30.'

name: Sara Liu
current_role: Co-founder, Senior Vice President and Director, Super Micro Computer Inc. (Supermicro)
deep_cut_fact: She holds a B.S. in accounting from Providence University in Taiwan, and also served as Supermicro's SVP of Operations from 2014 to early 2018.

name: George Sakellaris
current_role: Founder, Chairman, President and CEO, Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC), Framingham, MA
deep_cut_fact: He grew up in a small village outside Sparta, Greece, where a teacher told the math-gifted boy he must become either a teacher or an engineer; he chose engineering and came to the US to study EE at the University of Maine (Orono), later earning an MSEE and MBA at Northeastern.

name: Lady de Rothschild
current_role: Chair/owner, E.L. Rothschild (holding company); Founder, Council for Inclusive Capitalism
best_contact: press_email: media@inclusivecapitalism.com (Council for Inclusive Capitalism media contact)
deep_cut_fact: Energy angle: from 1998 to 2000 she served on the US Secretary of Energy's advisory committee, after serving on President Clinton's National Information Infrastructure Advisory Council (1993-95); early in her career she worked for telecom billionaire John Kluge.

name: Dipender Saluja
current_role: Managing Director, Capricorn Investment Group; managing partner, Capricorn Technology Impact Fund; director of QuantumScape, Joby Aviation and Navitas Semiconductor
deep_cut_fact: Before investing he was chief of staff at chip-design software firm Cadence, and earlier worked at Data General, Honeywell, ROLM (IBM) and GF Energy Research; he also sits on the external advisory board of the University of Minnesota's Institute on the Environment (since 2021).

name: Jihan Wu
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Bitdeer Technologies Group (NASDAQ: BTDR), Singapore
deep_cut_fact: He studied economics and psychology at Peking University and worked as a PE financial analyst. In May 2011 he raised 100,000 yuan from family and friends to buy about 900 bitcoins, and with Chang Jia co-founded Babite (8btc), China's first bitcoin community site.

name: Bahram Akradi
current_role: Founder, Chairman & CEO, Life Time Group Holdings (NYSE: LTH); Director, Northern Oil and Gas (NOG)
deep_cut_fact: As a boy he wanted to fly for the Iranian air force like his brother Davood, so he majored in electrical engineering at UC Colorado Springs as a route to aerospace. He cooked nights as 'Chef Akradi', outsold the local Nautilus gym's top salesman within 3 months, and drove a U-Haul to Minneapolis in March 1983.

name: Griffin Perry
current_role: Co-founder and ~11% shareholder, Fermi America (Nasdaq: FRMI); Co-Chairman, Granite Ridge Resources (NYSE: GRNT); co-founder, Grey Rock Investment Partners
deep_cut_fact: He began as a financial advisor at UBS and Deutsche Bank, was president of Caddis Energy, holds a BA in economics and history from Vanderbilt (plus study at the LSE) and sits on the board of the Cotton Bowl Athletic Association.

name: Satyanarayan Nandlal Nuwa
current_role: Chairman, Solar Industries India Ltd (Nagpur)
deep_cut_fact: He received the Padma Shri from the President of India in 2026; at Solar's 31st AGM he said he accepted it 'on behalf of every member of the Solar family' (about 15,100 people).

name: Jim Justice II
current_role: U.S. Senator (R) for West Virginia since January 2025; former two-term Governor of West Virginia (2017-2025)
deep_cut_fact: At Marshall University, where he earned a B.A. and MBA, he captained the golf team; his English bulldog Babydog, introduced at his 2021 inauguration, is described on his official Senate bio as 'the state's most famous four-legged celebrity'.

name: Manuel Alba
current_role: Independent Chair of the Board, Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB), since March 2018
deep_cut_fact: Before Astera, he was a co-founder, director and President of Israeli networking-chip company Galileo Technology (1994-2001); he has also been a director of Canadian asset-management software firm Copperleaf Technologies since 2010.

name: Michael Truett Tate
current_role: Former CFO of Astera Labs (ALAB), retired as CFO 2 Mar 2026; strategic advisor to CEO Jitendra Mohan through 1 Sep 2026
deep_cut_fact: He was CFO of Israeli chip start-up Annapurna Labs from June 2014 to January 2015 - the company Amazon acquired in 2015 and that went on to design AWS's Graviton and Trainium chips - and spent 2015-2020 as an angel investor/adviser to early-stage companies before joining Astera.

name: Howard S Jonas
current_role: Chairman, IDT Corp; Chairman, Genie Energy; Executive Chairman, CEO & President, Rafael Holdings; director, Zedge
deep_cut_fact: Asked about his first job, he said he had little jobs at the Bronx Zoo and a butcher shop, but his first real 'business' was a hot dog stand he opened at 14 near a local hospital - the origin of his 1998 memoir 'On a Roll: From Hot Dog Buns to High-Tech Billions'.

name: Jack Hightower
current_role: Founder and former Chairman/CEO, HighPeak Energy (NASDAQ: HPK); retired 15 Sept 2025, remains a major shareholder
deep_cut_fact: A 1970 Texas Tech graduate (BBA degrees in Administrative Finance and in Money, Banking & Investments), he chaired both Pure Resources (until Unocal's 2002 buyout) and, 15 years later, Pure Acquisition Corp. (2017), the SPAC that took HighPeak public.

name: Shawn Marie Soderberg
current_role: Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary, Bloom Energy Corp. (NYSE: BE), since January 2016
deep_cut_fact: Her first general counsel job, from 1994 to 1996, was VP and General Counsel of Microtec Research, a publicly traded maker of software tools for embedded systems. Later she was GC at Asian private-equity firm H&Q Asia Pacific.

name: Manish Satyanarayan Nuwal
current_role: Managing Director & CEO, Solar Industries India Ltd (Nagpur)
deep_cut_fact: A qualified chartered accountant, he says Solar's defence breakthrough was multi-mode hand grenades co-developed with DRDO over nearly three years, which he calls a watershed for private-sector defence in India; asked if 'playing with fire' is fun, he laughed.

name: Ayman Asfari
current_role: Co-founder, The Asfari Foundation (London); former CEO (2002-2020) of oilfield-services group Petrofac
deep_cut_fact: His first job was in Oman as a consulting engineer doing soil testing; when he joined Petrofac in 1991 it was essentially a single plant in Tyler, Texas. He won the UK EY Entrepreneur of the Year award in 2011.

name: Danny Sawrij
current_role: Owner and managing director/CEO of Leo Group (Halifax, West Yorkshire), animal by-products and renewable energy group
deep_cut_fact: In Oct 2023 he joined Kenny Logan's Rugby World Cup Challenge, a 700-mile walk/cycle from Edinburgh to Paris in seven days, raising money for the My Name'5 Doddie Foundation in memory of his friend and farm neighbour Doddie Weir.

name: Charles Wigoder
current_role: Non-Executive Chairman, Telecom Plus PLC (Utility Warehouse), LSE-listed multi-utility supplier
best_contact: pr_agency: FGS Global (Gordon Simpson / Emma Spencer), +44 20 7251 3801
deep_cut_fact: A University of Kent alumnus (accountancy and law), he gave GBP 1 million in 2013 to build a new home for the Kent Law Clinic, now named the Wigoder Law Building. He is also reported to be an expert contract-bridge player who won the Cavendish Invitational Teams in 2004 (unsourced on Wikipedia).

deep_cut_fact: Outside energy, he spent nine years in executive or non-executive director roles in the motorsport world with Lotus Cars and Caterham Cars.

name: Steven Meersman
current_role: Founder Director and board member, Zenobē (UK battery storage and electric-fleet company); leads the EV business
deep_cut_fact: He started his battery career on the team that set up AES Energy Storage (now Fluence), and later was Global Head of Deals Desk at Trafigura, running commercial optimisation and market risk for two refineries and over 30 import terminals and storage sites across Africa and Central America.

name: Raffi Garabedian
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, Electric Hydrogen Co.
deep_cut_fact: Before solar he spent 15+ years in MEMS, building products from automotive engine-control sensors to fiber-optic telecom switches, and was founding CEO of two startups that were acquired: Micromachines Inc. (by Kavlico) and Touchdown Technologies (by Agilent/Verigy).

name: David Eaglesham
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Electric Hydrogen (EH2), Devens/Natick, Massachusetts
deep_cut_fact: He is a past president of the Materials Research Society, and in that role called for a 'Manhattan Project' for renewable energy. In a 2012 interview at an Ypsilanti brewery he argued that the hunt for earth-abundant PV materials was 'working on the wrong problem' because efficiency matters more.

name: Derek Warnick
current_role: Co-founder and CFO, Electric Hydrogen (EH2)
deep_cut_fact: Before startups, Warnick began his career as a technical consultant at the World Bank.

name: Byung Joon Han
current_role: Co-founder, Board Director and CEO, Silicon Box (Singapore)
deep_cut_fact: Han holds over 300 patents. His teams drove commercial adoption of the quad flat no-lead (QFN) package, now shipped at over 100 billion units a year. He received the 2025 Leonardo International Prize for contributions to Italy's tech landscape. PhD, Columbia.

name: Vladimir Stojanovic
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer, Ayar Labs
deep_cut_fact: Trained at the University of Belgrade (Dipl. Ing. 1998) and Stanford (PhD 2005), he worked at Rambus on high-speed link technology from 2001-04 and also co-founded NanoSemi (later acquired by MaxLinear) and Numericcal, besides Ayar Labs.

name: Chen Sun
current_role: Co-founder, Chief Scientist (and VP Silicon Engineering per some listings), Ayar Labs
deep_cut_fact: The light-communicating chip was a cross-campus effort (Berkeley, MIT, CU Boulder); Sun's co-lead authors included Mark Wade (now Ayar's CEO) and Yunsup Lee, who later co-founded RISC-V company SiFive.

name: Mark Wade
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Ayar Labs (San Jose, CA)
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Ayar Labs he led the team that designed the optics in the world's first processor to communicate using light, results published in Nature in 2015. He earned his PhD at the University of Colorado.

name: Arvind Bansal
current_role: Founder, Whole-time Director and CEO, Continuum Green Energy Ltd (India); director of Singapore parent Continuum Green Energy Holdings
deep_cut_fact: He is a civil engineer by training (B.Tech, IIT Delhi) with a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad; Continuum's founding team were close friends from their IIM Ahmedabad days who left firms like IDFC-SSKI, Suzlon, Wipro and HSBC to start 'Continuum Wind Energy'.

name: Isaiah Taylor
current_role: Founder and CEO, Valar Atomics (El Segundo, CA; small modular / micro nuclear reactors)
deep_cut_fact: He learned to code at about age 10 after a software engineer at his church introduced him to a kids' programming language; by 16 he had decided to start Valar, but chose to build other companies first to gain experience. In Feb 2026 Valar's 5 MW reactor was airlifted to Utah aboard three Air Force cargo planes.

name: Jules Urbach
current_role: Founder, CEO & Chairman, OTOY; founder of the Render Network (decentralized GPU rendering)
deep_cut_fact: His first game was Hell Cab (Time Warner Interactive, 1993), made when he was just 18 and one of the first CD-ROM games ever created; before OTOY he built the web's first 3D game platform, licensed to Disney, Warner Bros., Microsoft and others.

name: Doug Bernauer
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Radiant Industries (Radiant Nuclear), El Segundo, CA
deep_cut_fact: At SpaceX he led avionics for Grasshopper and worked on 'Elon's side-projects' (Hyperloop, The Boring Company); tasked with powering a Mars colony, he found solar would need 'three football fields' of panels, built a nuclear trade-study model — and jokes that when asked where he went to school, he answers 'SpaceX.'

name: Ezra Feilden
current_role: Co-founder & CTO, Starcloud (formerly Lumen Orbit), Redmond, WA - orbital AI data centers
deep_cut_fact: Before space hardware, his Imperial College materials PhD work was on 3D-printing ceramics: e.g. a 2019 Ceramics International paper on the high-temperature strength of an ultra-high-temperature ceramic produced by additive manufacturing (with Saiz and Vandeperre).
